subject: Hearts lose 1-3 at Thun, slipping towards the foot of the Conference League table
title: Hearts at Thun: one point in three

lines.vo: One point from three games. Then Hearts went to Switzerland.
lines.footage: Thun vs Hearts highlights, Stockhorn Arena wide shot

lines.vo: Thun won three-one at the Stockhorn Arena. Hearts left with one goal and homework.
lines.footage: goal clips from the match, scoreboard

lines.vo: They started the night thirty-second out of thirty-six. That is not a typo.
Before that: seven-one at Celtic Park. Two-nil at Trabzonspor. Three-one at Thun. Quite the tour.
lines.footage: Celtic Park exterior, Trabzonspor match b-roll, away fans

lines.vo: Hearts did get one back late on. Credit for effort.
One point from four games now. The foot of the table is getting closer.

inserts.story: Setup: a clean-line fan studies a thirty-six-line table with a magnifying glass. Gag: he starts at the top, gives up, and reads from the bottom. Twist: he finds his team, and the glass fogs up.
Setup: a clean-line bus driver checks a map marked Celtic Park, Trabzonspor, Thun. Gag: at each stop the passengers get quieter. Twist: at the last stop, the bus sighs louder than the fans.
inserts.characters: Generic bus driver caricature, bus prop

inserts.story: Setup: a caricature goalkeeper fishes a ball out of the net, three times. Gag: he finds one in the other net and holds it like a trophy. Twist: the full-time whistle blows and he puts it back, politely.

facts_used: Thun won 3-1 at the Stockhorn Arena; only the 3-1 score is firm, the scorers differ between the match header and the shot map (news 431, espn.com)
Hearts had 1 point from three games before the match and sat 32nd in the 36-team table (news 431)
Hearts arrived after a 7-1 league defeat at Celtic Park on 18 October and a 2-0 loss at Trabzonspor (news 431, background)
notes: Source: news 431 (ESPN, 2026-11-05). No player names used: scorers conflict between sources, and the own goal is not named. Only the 3-1 score is firm. 'Late on' rests on the 82nd-minute entry in the header, which the shot map may not confirm; check before publishing. 'Homework' and 'quite the tour' are gags on results only. Hearts are described as closer to the foot of the table, not as bottom. Inserts are generic caricatures. after_line is the 0-based index into lines[].
